pin_risk.explanation: Spot sits 0.39% from 425, which carries 100% of the largest single-strike gamma in the chain. Nearest expiry is 0.1 DTE and same-day gamma is 100% of total. This is a heuristic score, not a forecast.

regime.explanation: Spot is only 0.32% from the modelled gamma flip at 428.04. Dealer hedging direction can invert on a small move, so expect unstable intraday behaviour around this level. Same-day expiries dominate the total, so the regime can reset after the close.

/api/options/MSFT/oi.oi_note: Open interest is published once per session and is not tick-by-tick. Figures reflect the previous reporting session unless the provider states otherwise.

change.reason: No prior session stored yet. Run the app across two sessions.

/api/options/MSFT/iv.historical_note: IV Rank and IV Percentile require a historical IV series. Set ORATS_API_KEY to enable them.

summary.note: Aggressor tagging reflects print location versus quote only. It does not identify opening versus closing trades or directional intent.

/api/options/MSFT/flow.note: Call does not mean bullish and put does not mean bearish. Aggressor tagging describes where the print landed in the quote, nothing more.

/api/history/MSFT/gex.note: History accumulates while the app runs; each dashboard refresh records one point. An empty series simply means nothing has been captured yet.
